correctness.rationale: For equal-weight regular grids Dn⊂[0,1], ordinary k-means++ chooses X uniform and second point with D² weights; there are precisely two seeds, no Lloyd update, optimal comparison centers may be real. The continuum conditional density is (y−x)²/V(x), V=x²−x+1/3≥1/12. Splitting the Voronoi integral at (x+y)/2 and independently integrating exact polynomials reproduces Q(x)=(-66x^6+198x^5−135x^4−60x³+105x²−42x+7)/360 and E C=−3/400+11√3 π/1215. The continuum optimal two-mean cost is 1/48 at 1/4,3/4; uniform Riemann-sum convergence of both expected sampling objective (denominator bounded below) and compact minimization justifies limit from grids. Hence exact ratio 176√3 π/405−9/25≈2.0046569489>2. Independent symbolic integral and Q polynomial differences checked to zero. Does NOT claim a worst-case data set optimizer, finite-n formula or post-refinement cost.
